info.name: Shop MilkTea - Full Coverage (via API Gateway)
info.description:
Postman collection test FULL toan bo 6 microservice, MOI request deu di qua API-GATEWAY ({{gateway_url}} = http://localhost:9000), KHONG goi truc tiep service.

Cac dinh tuyen tren Gateway (src .../gateway/routes/Routes.java):
- /api/auth/** , /api/accounts/**        -> customer-service :8081
- /api/categories/** , /api/milkteas/** , /api/toppings/** , /api/sizes/** -> inventory-service :8082
- /api/orders/** , /api/carts/**         -> order-service :8083
- /api/payments/**                       -> payment-service :8084
- /api/reports/**                        -> report-service :8085

QUY TRINH CHAY: Run collection theo thu tu folder 00 -> 10 (Postman Runner).
1) '00 Setup & Auth': dang nhap ADMIN bang tai khoan seed trong DB (admin_db / password123, Flyway V2__seed_test_accounts.sql) + dang ky CUSTOMER, tu dong luu token vao bien admin_token / customer_token).
2) Cac folder sau dung token do de kiem thu tung service nghiep vu.
3) Gia tri id (category_id, milktea_id, order_code ...) duoc gan lai tu dong bang test script de chain giua cac request.
4) Folder cuoi chua cac testcase Negative/Security (401/403/400/404).

LUU Y BAO MAT: /api/auth/register LUON tao tai khoan CUSTOMER - truong 'role' gui len bi bo qua (chong tu phong ADMIN). Dang ky cong khai KHONG tao duoc ADMIN; tai khoan ADMIN chi co san tu DB (seed: admin_db / password123) hoac in-memory tu cau hinh (admin / admin123).

CAP NHAT RESILIENCE4J: Folder '11 Circuit Breaker' thu nghiem circuit breaker o order-service (order -> inventory). Rieng request xem actuator goi TRUC TIEP {{order_service_url}} (http://localhost:8083) - ngoai le duy nhat cua quy tac 'chi di qua gateway'.

item.name: 11 Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j) - order-service
item.description:
Thu nghiem Resilience4j Circuit Breaker cua order-service (order -> inventory qua OpenFeign). Cau hinh trong order-service/application.properties: mo breaker sau toi thieu 5 lan goi voi >= 50% loi (hoac >= 80% goi cham > 3s); mo trong 15s; TimeLimiter 6s; Feign timeout 2s/5s; retry 2 lan cho loi mang tam thoi.

QUY TRINH DEMO:
CB 1 - moi service SONG -> 201 (baseline).
CB 2 - TAT inventory-service roi chay trong Collection Runner 8 lan: ~5 lan dau 400 (breaker CLOSED), tu lan 6 tro di 503 TUC THI (breaker OPEN).
CB 3 - xem trang thai breaker qua actuator cua order-service (goi TRUC TIEP, khong qua gateway).
CB 4 - BAT LAI inventory-service, CHO DU 15s, goi lai -> breaker tu dong khoi phuc (HALF-OPEN -> CLOSED).

item.name: CB 1 - Moi service SONG: them mon vao gio (ky vong 201)

exec: pm.test('HTTP 201 neu du lieu khop DB (400 nghia la milkTeaId/unitPrice chua dung - chay folder 05 truoc de co du lieu dung)', function () {
console.log('CB 1: HTTP', pm.response.code, 'trong', pm.response.responseTime, 'ms - baseline khi inventory SONG');

request.description: Request di qua gateway -> order-service -> (Feign + CircuitBreaker) -> inventory-service. Doi milkTeaId/unitPrice theo DB inventory cua ban (hoac chay folder 05 truoc roi dung {{milktea_id}} / {{milktea_price}}).

item.name: CB 2 - Inventory CHET: breaker mo dan (400 cham -> 503 TUC THI)

exec: pm.test('Inventory CHET: 400 khi breaker con CLOSED, 503 khi breaker da OPEN, 201 neu inventory van SONG', function () {
pm.test('Circuit Breaker OPEN: 503 phai tra ve TUC THI (< 1s)', function () {
console.log('Inventory van SONG nen request thanh cong 201. De demo breaker mo: tat inventory truoc roi chay rieng request nay 8 lan (xem description).');

request.description: QUY TRINH: (1) Tat inventory-service: Get-Process -Id (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8082 -State Listen).OwningProcess | Stop-Process -Force  (2) Chay request nay trong Collection Runner 8 lan. Ky vong: ~5 lan dau tra 400 moi lan ~0.5-1.5s (breaker CLOSED, co 1 retry ben trong); tu lan thu 6 tro di tra 503 TUC THI < 100ms (breaker OPEN - khong con ket noi ra ngoai). LUU Y: khi chay FULL collection (inventory con SONG) request nay tra 201 - test van PASS, chi in log huong dan. Log order-service in 'Circuit Breaker OPEN - tu choi goi inventory-service...' khi breaker mo.

item.name: CB 3 - Xem trang thai breaker (actuator order-service, goi TRUC TIEP)

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 (neu 404: ban Spring Cloud hien tai khong kem module actuator cua Resilience4j - dung log va hanh vi 503 tuc thi lam bang chung)', function () {

request.description: GOI TRUC TIEP order-service ({{order_service_url}} = http://localhost:8083) - ngoai le duy nhat khong di qua gateway. Endpoint khac: /actuator/circuitbreakerevents (su kien mo/dong breaker), /actuator/health.

item.name: CB 4 - Inventory ON LAI, cho 15s: breaker tu khoi phuc (ky vong 201)

exec: pm.test('Sau khi inventory ON LAI va breaker hoan phuc: 201 (400 neu milkTeaId/unitPrice chua khop DB)', function () {
console.log('CB 4: HTTP', pm.response.code, '- neu 201 thi circuit da tu dong dong lai (CLOSED)');

request.description: CHUA LAI TU DONG: Bat lai inventory-service, CHO DU 15 giay (wait-duration-in-open-state) roi moi goi. Lan dau breaker di qua HALF-OPEN (toi da 3 request thu nghiem); neu thanh cong -> CLOSED, hoi phuc hoan toan KHONG can restart order-service. Goi truoc khi du 15s van nhan 503 tuc thi.
